title: Night Cream After Waxing or Threading: What to Use and When
ex: Use a plain, soothing moisturiser after waxing, threading or face bleach, and pause active night creams for about 24 to 48 hours. Timings by area.
rt: Night Cream After Waxing or Threading: When to Use | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream after waxing, threading or face bleach: what to use the first night, when to go back to kojic acid or glutathione creams, and how to avoid bumps.
quick: After waxing, threading or face bleach, use only a plain, fragrance-free moisturiser on the area. Skip creams with kojic acid, glutathione, vitamin C, alpha arbutin or retinol for about 24 to 48 hours, then bring them back every second night once the skin feels calm.
facts: Pause active creams for about 24 to 48 hours
Use a plain, fragrance-free moisturiser on the area
Threaded brows: keep active cream off that area for a day
